Done! I've added `addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })` and `removeLine(invoice, sku)` to src/invoices.js:

- **addLine** — Adds a new line or increases qty if SKU already exists; validates qty and SKU; returns NOT_DRAFT if invoice isn't editable
- **removeLine** — Removes a line by SKU; prevents removing the last line (NO_LINES) or when invoice isn't draft (NOT_DRAFT); returns LINE_NOT_FOUND if SKU not present

Added two new error codes: NOT_DRAFT and LINE_NOT_FOUND. Added 11 new tests covering adding new/existing lines, validation errors, draft enforcement, and mutation safety. All 44 tests pass.
